subject.title: Feishu plugin WebSocket doesn't receive im.message.receive_v1 events

question: Should a Feishu-capable maintainer run live WebSocket diagnostics for this issue before deciding whether it is covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92595 or needs a separate transport/subscription fix?
rationale: Source inspection proves the intended local handler wiring, but only live Feishu proof can distinguish platform subscription, SDK dispatch, malformed payload, and OpenClaw routing causes for this specific lifecycle-events-still-arrive report.

options.title: Run live Feishu diagnostics
options.body: Keep this issue open and capture redacted current-main or latest-release logs that show whether `im.message.receive_v1` reaches the SDK dispatcher and OpenClaw handler.

options.title: Fold into broader inbound work if logs match
options.body: If live logs match the already-known partial-runtime or broader inbound-reply failure, close this as covered by the canonical related issue or merged fix with that proof.

options.title: Track separate transport/subscription bug
options.body: If lifecycle events arrive but message frames never reach the dispatcher, keep this as the specific Feishu WebSocket subscription or SDK-delivery investigation.

recommendation.title: Run live Feishu diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and capture redacted current-main or latest-release logs that show whether `im.message.receive_v1` reaches the SDK dispatcher and OpenClaw handler.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin maintenance contact, and the remaining decision needs Feishu-specific live channel knowledge.
